description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Ulrich.
When Ulrich enters, it triggers, giving Devoted Druid +4/+4 until end of turn.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.name: Ulrich of the Krallenhorde // Ulrich, Uncontested Alpha
